turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Put the doer first, then the action, then the thing; put place or time at the end.
Right: "The farmer feeds the cows."
Wrong: "Feeds the farmer the cows." The action comes before the doer, so it is wrong.
My example: "The monkey eats a banana." Doer: the monkey. Action: eats. Thing: a banana.
Now you. Put in order:
"plays / Sam / chess / on Mondays"
